title: AcornAddon
description: A addon to the mod Melinoe. Adds features like chat shortcuts, auto gg and more.
body:
## Features

### Auto React
Never miss a moment worth reacting to. Acorn automatically sends reactions in chat when notable events happen on your server.

- **Auto F** — Automatically sends a message (default: `f`) when a player death is announced, so you never have to type it manually.
- **Auto GG** — Automatically sends a message (default: `gg`) when:
  - A **Bloodshot**, **Unholy**, or **Companion** item drop is broadcast
  - A player **fully transcends** a class (e.g. `Has just fully transcended Samurai! (3/6)`)

Each rarity and transcend event can be individually toggled on or off. Cross-server broadcasts are filtered out — reactions only fire for events on your current hub. A built-in 1.5-second cooldown prevents spam.

### Chat Shortcuts
Tired of switching chat modes manually? Acorn adds client-side commands for instantly sending messages to any channel:

| Command | Channel |
|---|---|
| `/ac <message>` | Default chat |
| `/gc <message>` | Guild chat |
| `/cc <message>` | Group chat |

A **Default Chat** setting lets you configure which channel you return to after using a shortcut.

---

## Requirements
- Minecraft **1.21.10**
- [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/)
- [Melinoe](https://modrinth.com/mod/melinoe) *(required)*

---

*Acorn is a community addon built for Telos Realms players. Join the [Discord](https://serverhub.xyz/archon) for support.*
